sql: with p as (  select market_ticker t, split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) ser, split_part(market_ticker,'-',2) ev, strategy, side, assumed_price px, quantity q, pnl, created_at, resolved_value rv  from paper_trades  where split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) in ('KXITFMATCH','KXITFWMATCH','KXATPCHALLENGERMATCH','KXWTACHALLENGERMATCH') and status in ('settled','closed_sl')    and strategy ilike '%mmsell%' and strategy not like '%\_pt%' and pnl is not null and quantity>0), mk as (  select p.ser, p.ev, p.t, avg(px) px, 100*sum(pnl)/sum(q) cpc, bool_or(pnl<0) lost, min(p.created_at) c0, max(rv) rv,   extract(epoch from (min(s.close_time) - case when p.ser like 'KXITF%' then interval '330 hours' else interval '333 hours' end - min(p.created_at)))/3600 he  from p left join mmsell_settlement_meta s on s.market_ticker=p.t group by 1,2,3), x as (  select ser, ev, t, cpc, lost, 100-px tail, rv,   case when 100-px<=7 then 'b6-7' when 100-px<=10 then 'c8-10' when 100-px<=20 then 'd11-20' else 'e>20' end band,   case when he is null then 'z?' when he>6 then 'a>6h' when he>3 then 'b3-6h' when he>1 then 'c1-3h' when he>0 then 'd0-1h' when he>-1 then 'e-1-0h' else 'f<-1h' end clk  from mk), cells as (  select 'clk(<=10c)' dim, ser, clk cell, ev, t, cpc, lost, tail, rv from x where tail<=10  union all select 'clk(>10c)', ser, clk, ev, t, cpc, lost, tail, rv from x where tail>10), g as (select dim, ser, cell, ev, sum(cpc)/100.0 gp from cells group by 1,2,3,4), gs as (select dim, ser, cell, count(*) games, round(avg(gp)::numeric,4) mean_g, round((stddev_samp(gp)/sqrt(count(*)))::numeric,4) se_g from g group by 1,2,3) select c.dim, c.ser, c.cell, count(*) mkts, round(avg(c.tail),2) be_pct, round(100*avg(case when c.lost then 1 else 0 end),2) loss_pct,  sum(case when c.lost then 1 else 0 end) n_lost, count(*) filter (where c.rv not in (0,100)) n_half, round(avg(c.cpc),2) c_per_mkt, gs.games, gs.mean_g, gs.se_g from cells c join gs on gs.dim=c.dim and gs.ser=c.ser and gs.cell=c.cell group by 1,2,3, gs.games, gs.mean_g, gs.se_g union all select 'rv/status', split_part(market_ticker,'-',1), status||' rv='||coalesce(resolved_value::text,'null'), count(*), null, null, null, null, round(100*sum(pnl)/nullif(sum(quantity),0),2), null, null, null from paper_trades where split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) in ('KXITFMATCH','KXITFWMATCH','KXATPCHALLENGERMATCH','KXWTACHALLENGERMATCH') and strategy ilike '%mmsell%' group by 2,3 order by 1,2,3
